summary: A tracked troop carrier with a fast-firing 25 mm autocannon. It shreds light vehicles, infantry and low drones, and carries a squad safely to the front.

sections.title: Autocannon
sections.how: Select the Bradley and right-click an enemy, or let it fire at anything in range.
sections.body: The Bushmaster fires short, quick bursts. It is deadly against infantry, scouts, other infantry fighting vehicles and low drones, but barely scratches a main battle tank.

sections.title: Carry infantry
sections.how: Select infantry, then left-click the Bradley.
sections.body: Up to six soldiers ride inside. Riders take only a tenth of the damage the vehicle takes, but they cannot shoot out: the Bradley has no firing ports. Riders cannot be selected until they leave.

sections.title: Unload
sections.how: Select the loaded Bradley and press Unload (n).
sections.body: The riders step out one after another beside the vehicle. Drive close to the objective first, then unload.

sections.title: Repair at the vehicle factory
sections.how: Select the damaged Bradley and press Repair at factory, or left-click your vehicle factory.
sections.body: The Bradley drives to the factory and is repaired for half its price, paid as the health comes back.

tips: Pair it with tanks: the tank fights armour, the Bradley clears the infantry around it.
Unload anti-tank teams behind cover instead of driving the Bradley into a tank.
